name: st-preset-dismantle
description: Dissects SillyTavern Chat Completion presets using SillyTavern's own dry-run prompt assembly.

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of process.argv.slice(1)) require('node:child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], {stdio: 'inherit'})" extension/index.js extension/src/*.js cli/*.mjs
